messages:
katie: Heads up — we need a compact telemetry contract for Hosted + Dedicated GPU pools that covers SM headroom, per-pool queue depth, and memory pressure. Can owners volunteer?

raj: I can own the schema for SM-level signals. thinking metrics: sm_occupancy_pct, sm_active_warps, sm_mem_used_bytes, sm_mem_total_bytes.

mike: +1. For queue depth we should differentiate request queue vs internal batching queue. propose: request_queue_depth, batch_pending_count.

olivia: UX/console here — we need aggregated headroom and a 95th percentile tail for slot waiting time. Otherwise rollouts will look green but users will see long tails.

katie: good call. add: slot_wait_p95_ms, slot_wait_p50_ms. Also want an alerting signal: pool_headroom_pct < 10% sustained 5m.

raj: quick proto of a metrics payload (for runtime -> telemetry):
```
{
  "pool_id": "hosted-a-1",
  "ts": 1987654321,
  "sm": { "occupancy_pct": 72.3, "active_warps": 128 },
  "memory": { "used_bytes": 1234567890, "total_bytes": 17179869184 },
  "queues": { "request_queue_depth": 6, "batch_pending_count": 2 },
  "slot_wait_p95_ms": 1200
}
```
raj: runtime team can emit that every 15s per pool. thoughts on granularity?

dave: emitting every 15s is fine for dashboards, but for SLOs/alerts we should have 1m rollups and 1h retention for rollouts. Longer retention for aggregated cost analysis.

mike: agree on rollups. Also call out metric cardinality — pool_id + model_variant is ok, but avoid per-request ids. we should document label set.

olivia: console: we'll want these as templated charts: headroom over time, queue depth heatmap, memory utilization per host and per pool, and a rollout overlay (traffic %). Need the rollout metadata tag on metrics (rollout_id).

katie: excellent — add rollout_id label optional. Also need an eviction indicator: kernel_evictions_count or sm_eviction_rate. this will help explain sudden drops in throughput.

raj: I'll add eviction counters: sm_evictions_total (counter) + sm_eviction_rate_per_min.

eng-sre-bot: deploy ping — metrics schema change request submitted: MTR-2026-87.

mike: ops note: for Dedicated, the KM-instrumentation path differs (on-prem exporter). runtime team — can you provide a small shim that emits the same JSON to both hosted ingest and a local Prometheus exporter?

raj: yes, we can add a local exporter endpoint that maps the JSON to Prometheus exposition format. will include example config and a small sidecar.

olivia: timeline ask from product: console needs first-pass charts and alerting by next week for a Dedicated pilot. can we aim for a minimal set: sm_occupancy_pct, request_queue_depth, slot_wait_p95_ms, pool_headroom_pct, sm_evictions_total?

katie: two-phase plan: phase 1 (MVP) emit + dashboard + basic alerts; phase 2 add per-host memory breakdown, queue heatmaps, and rollout overlays. phase 1 target = 7 days.

dave: I'll create alert playbooks for the pool_headroom_pct and slot_wait_p95_ms alerts, include runbook steps and escalation.

mike: one more: include a sample dashboard JSON export (grafana/console) in the PR so CI can validate panels map to metrics.

raj: ack — I'll open a PR with schema, exporter shim, and dashboard JSON stub. tagging @mike @olivia for review.

katie: thanks everyone. assign owners: schema + runtime shim = raj, dashboards = olivia, alerts/runbooks = dave, rollout/QA = mike. please update the PR checklist. :thumbsup:
